issue.title: Gist clips record a numeric author (262588213843476) and an <owner>/<file>.md title
issue.description:
Proposed by the bob-cli-7x epic plan (plan:202610/bob_ref_rename.md, phase `namer`, and its "Out of scope" list: "The gist's bad title and author host metadata"). The `namer` phase (bob-cli-7x.1) was told to record this as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP but never did; the bob-cli-7x land agent files it here.

## Evidence (live vault, read-only)

`ref/blogs/karpathy_llm_wiki.md` (formerly `442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f.md`), captured 2026-10-15 by `bob ref create https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f`:

```
title: karpathy/llm-wiki.md
author: "262588213843476"
published: 2026-04-04
source_url: "https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f"
```

- `author` is an opaque number, not `karpathy` (the gist owner is in the URL path and on the page).
- `title` is the gist's `<owner>/<filename>` page title, file extension included, rather than a human title (for example the Markdown's first heading).

## Where to look

The web-clip adapter's metadata layering: `scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py` `layer_author` (around line 252) and its call site (around line 1519) that layers JSON-LD, meta (`articleAuthor`/`author`), byline, and Defuddle author candidates. One of those sources yields the numeric value for gist.github.com pages. A host-specific rule (gist owner from the URL path, or rejecting all-digit author candidates) and a title cleanup for `<owner>/<file>.md` gist titles are the likely remediations; confirm against a captured gist page before choosing.

## Notes

- Existing references never change automatically; fixing the live note's `author`/`title` is a separate manual edit (`title:` edit plus `bob ref sync lib/blogs/karpathy_llm_wiki.pdf -p frontmatter -w`, per docs/ref.md).
- The stem side of this incident (opaque hex stems, `.md` in title-derived stems) is handled by bob-cli-7x, not here.

task_type_fields.impact: Every GitHub gist reference gets a meaningless author and a filename-shaped title, which shows in bob ref list/show, Bob Refs, and title-derived names.
task_type_fields.location: scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py layer_author (~line 252) and its call site (~line 1519)
task_type_fields.repro: bob ref create https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f -d (or inspect live ~/bob/ref/blogs/karpathy_llm_wiki.md frontmatter): author is "262588213843476" and title is "karpathy/llm-wiki.md".

payload.entry: Fixed by batch-7 phase .2 commit e3754c0d: for gist.github.com final URLs the web-clip adapter takes the author from the owner/id path (karpathy, provenance gist-owner) and the title from the first Markdown H1 across Gist files, falling back to the first readable filename (provenance gist-filename); explicit CLI title/author overrides still apply afterward, and non-Gist numeric authors stay eligible (self-test control). Offline fixtures gist_karpathy.html and gist_multiple_no_h1.html exercise the browser path. Lander re-verified 2026-10-25: just check-web-clip-adapter exits ok with the browser fixture path executing (no no-browser skip); Rust contract test capture_success_preserves_gist_metadata_and_provenance passes; just check exit 0. Existing live references are not rewritten (separate manual edit per docs/ref.md).
